howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在不同会话、主题、模态（如聊天、语音、邮件）和用户之间保持行为一致，避免随机变化，确保可预测的交互体验。
howto.when: 当 Claude 检测到会话切换、主题改变或用户请求保持一致行为时，自动应用一致性准则。

say.text: 请保持和上次一样的回答风格。
say.note: Claude 会参考历史记录维持行为一致。
Claude 会调整输出以匹配之前的语气。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude behaves predictably across sessions, topics, modalities (chat, voice, email), and users, avoiding random changes to ensure a reliable interaction experience.
howto.when_en: When Claude detects a session switch, topic change, or a user request for consistent behavior, it automatically applies consistency guidelines.

say_en.text: Please maintain the same style as your last response.
say_en.note: Claude references history to keep behavior consistent.
Claude adjusts output to match previous tone.
